limitations: Printed parameters and calculated ratios have finite precision.
Conditional independent fits assume diagonal PVT errors and a 0.005 GPa diagnostic floor for printed-zero DAC errors; not EoSFit7 workflow parity.
Cold LVP rows are separately included as a sensitivity case; source row flags and original EoSFit7 project files are unavailable.
Benchmarks beyond data coverage and molten flags do not extend validity.
